evals.prompt: Create a complete brand kit and logo system for 'Kiln & Crumb', an artisanal neighbourhood sourdough bakery and specialty coffee roaster. It should feel warm, architectural, and modern—definitely not rustic clip-art with wheat stalks, rolling pins, or steaming coffee mugs.
evals.expected_output: An 8-module interactive brand-board.html, audited SVG logo files (primary lockup, standalone mark, monochrome ink, inverted light, favicon), site.webmanifest, brand-tokens.json, and a contrast-verified warm artisanal color and typography system.
expectations: Avoids banned bakery and coffee cliches (no wheat stalks, rolling pins, chef hats, or steaming mugs)
Runs brand_audit.py and achieves a passing score (>= 90/100) on SVG geometry and WCAG color contrast
Uses undertone-tinted canvas and ink colors rather than raw #FFFFFF and #000000
Generates the 8-module brand-board.html and production SVG/token bundle via generate_brand_board.py

evals.prompt: Design a logo and brand identity kit for 'Kitewire', a developer platform for testing and deploying autonomous AI agents. Make sure it doesn't look like typical AI slop (no sparkles, brains, neural nets, or purple-blue neon gradients).
evals.expected_output: A high-craft technical brand identity system with geometric SVG marks tested down to 16px, a non-cliche palette (such as carbon ink, warm putty, and signal vermilion or updraft yellow), technical typography pairing, and exported asset kit.
expectations: Explicitly avoids AI cliches (sparkles, brains, circuits, robot heads) and purple/blue neon gradients
Includes 64px, 32px, and 16px small-size pixel ladder verification
Defines a 6-role color palette with verified WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios and surface polarity rules
Exports logo-primary.svg, logo-mark.svg, favicon.svg, brand-tokens.json, and brand-board.html

evals.prompt: We're launching 'Northvault', a digital business banking and automated tax-pot app for independent designers and freelancers. Build us 3 distinct logo concepts at a checkpoint sheet first, plus recommend a bold, non-boring color and font system (no bank blue, coins, shields, or piggy banks).
evals.expected_output: A 3-concept checkpoint HTML sheet comparing three distinct SVG mark archetypes across light, dark, and signature stages with 64/32/16px scale tests and a contrast-verified palette.
expectations: Avoids fintech cliches (no bank blue, coins, piggy banks, calculators, or shields)
Presents 3 distinct SVG mark concepts with honest misread/risk notes and a clear recommendation
Verifies SVG anchor economy and minimum gap floor using brand_audit.py
Generates concept-checkpoint.html or brand-board.html with live WCAG contrast scores
